covered_voter_classes.plain_language: A member of the Uniformed Services or Merchant Marine voting away from the voting residence.
An eligible spouse or dependent covered by UOCAVA.
A U.S. citizen residing outside the United States.

request_and_registration_paths.plain_language: Use the FPCA to register, request your absentee ballot, or update your contact information.
request_and_registration_paths.deadline_note: Submit the FPCA as early as possible; check state-specific deadlines and delivery instructions.

ballot_delivery_options.plain_language: Blank ballot materials may be delivered electronically when allowed by law and the voter requests that option.
Official ballot materials may also be transmitted by mail according to the voter’s instructions and state law.

backup_ballot_path.plain_language: Use the FWAB as the official backup ballot path if you made a timely ballot request but do not receive the ballot in time.

tracking_path.plain_language: Check whether your ballot was received using the official free-access tracking path.

service_assistance_paths.plain_language: Military voters can get help from their Installation Voter Assistance Office or equivalent service voting office.
Overseas citizens can use the official embassy or consulate help path when local assistance is needed.

local_election_office_path.plain_language: Contact your local election office for state-specific instructions, request status, and return options.

freshness_note: The UOCAVA public surface is rechecked whenever deadlines, mailing conditions, or help routing change.
